## 1. Prediction market

In the [Polymarket winner contract](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election), confirmed reading of September 27, 12:47 BRT, Flávio Bolsonaro rises 1.10pp, to 57.25% (USD 11.96M), and Lula stands still at 42.50% (USD 12.40M), against the reading of September 26, 12:00 BRT. The gap goes from 13.65pp to 14.75pp, the second widening in a row between confirmed readings. With the pair sum rising from 98.65 to 99.75, the normalized move is 0.48pp to each side, and more than half of the raw rise comes from the sum. Total accumulated volume in the presidential book adds up to USD 155.76M across 19 contracts.

Neither of them is at an extreme of the series recorded since April 14: Flávio Bolsonaro stands 4.45pp from the top, of September 21, and Lula 8.00pp from the floor, of April 25. The Renan Santos contract, standing still at 0.45% (USD 14.52M), remains the one with the largest accumulated volume in the presidential book.

In the [third place book](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-3rd-place), Augusto Cury rises 3.05pp, to 44.40% (USD 0.29M), and Renan Santos falls 4.00pp, to 41.50% (USD 0.43M). Normalized by the book sum, the moves are 3.37pp and 3.51pp. The distance goes from Renan Santos 4.15pp ahead to Augusto Cury 2.90pp ahead, and Ronaldo Caiado remains at 14.50% (USD 0.17M). In the [second place one](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-presidential-election-first-round-2nd-place), Lula rises 1.00pp, to 25.45% (USD 1.04M), and Flávio Bolsonaro stays at 74.50% (USD 1.19M).

The [Supreme Court impeachment contract](https://polymarket.com/event/any-brazil-stf-justice-removed-by-impeachment-before-2027) falls 0.35pp, to 3.00% (USD 0.09M). In the [2026 inflation one](https://polymarket.com/event/brazil-annual-inflation-2026), the 5.00% to 5.49% band leads with 48.35% (USD 0.02M), in the 13:21 BRT reading.

## 2. What the polling firms registered

No national voting intention poll was released from September 25 to 27, and the six of September 24 remain the most recent. The Datafolha poll of September 26 measured institutions: [47% rate the work of the Supreme Court justices as bad or very bad](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiswFBVV95cUxOZXk0d0VKakRJZk9WMktiR3Z4RnpoZzJQTjRxTjJaTGVoV1JIRTNrRWJEQXBKdGxRYkpuZndRc0FxWnpzak14cUU4Rl9ZNVR1NFJ4S1ZjR1BfVWxCdXRocEZtSHJJTUhHRFQ3cVI4QjJSd3F1VUJqWjJrNnlVdTZzMDJWYVBiVGJVQmNQQTJXanV4WlNybUJwajRWZ29YVE9PMGJBT0pDUl9sVnhJeHo4cGZGQQ?oc=5), the highest level in the series started in 2019, and [37% rate Congress that way, against 18% who rate it excellent or good](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5).

In the states, the Quaest poll of Pará, released on September 26 with fieldwork from September 22 to 25, puts [Lula at 40% and Flávio Bolsonaro at 35%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxOVG1jZHdDUC04enhFa0g0TzhYdk9FN1hweThNNFN6bnY1ZUZ1QjhSM2M2QWVKaDBIX0RFYzlsN2JINDdDOFg5cVhiazNqRWN5dXQxb3pDSDhub3BuRXptQ0pQaGhlcC1YS0lEM212Ukg0TlgtR3NrMWV2U3JGNnRXWWlEUF9aQ3VNWjR3OTRGS1FmMUxDZk53QmRKcHFIN0xt?oc=5), and Augusto Cury third, with 7%. With the state breakdowns from Datafolha and Quaest, UOL counts [Lula ahead in 11 states, Flávio Bolsonaro in eight and in the Federal District](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiigFBVV95cUxNMnVMWmlQSXFpTEFxaWF6QkpSQndja19LNVFkWGZCb1AyU1BDM1hhRFQwMG5XVEk1ekJrbktUYlZ5WkR0UThDUVE3c3Z0eEpYT056MGRFTG9jVVlSVHY3a0VoSnJETHR0M3dmTWR0c1VjMTluQ0Z6REpxcmlRSlZxNVc1MG9KYm5zSWc?oc=5), and a statistical tie in the other seven units.

The TSE reported on September 26 that Kassio Nunes Marques [changed the poll registration system](https://news.google.?oc=5): firms now report whether they used audio, video or images in the interviews and the order of the questions, which, according to the court, creates no new obligation. The registry adds up to 1,234 presidential polls, 72 more than on September 26. The next national Quaest poll, of September 28, has [fieldwork from September 24 to 27](https://news.google.?oc=5), which spans the provisional measure on betting sites, of September 25.

## 3. What the press covered

The TSE president, Kassio Nunes Marques, [suspended by injunction the jingle "Foi o Flávio Bolsonaro" ("It was Flávio Bolsonaro")](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-?oc=5), from Lula's campaign, which links the opponent to the rachadinha (salary kickback scheme) and to the Master case. The decision was [signed on September 22](https://news.google.?oc=5), became public on September 26 and was submitted to the full court. On September 27, Flávio Dino, of the Supreme Court, in a single-justice ruling, [overturned André Mendonça's order at the TSE](https://jovempan.com.br/politica/dino-derruba-decisao-de-mendonca-que-mandou-apagar-post-de-humorista-sobre-nossa-senhora-a-pedido-de-flavio/) that had ordered the deletion of a post by comedian Antonio Tabet about Our Lady of Aparecida, and [ordered the platforms to restore the publications removed](https://www.brasil247.com/poder/dino-derruba-decisao-de-mendonca-e-restabelece-postagem-de-tabet-sobre-nossa-senhora-aparecida) on the same grounds.

Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign [filed on September 25 a criminal complaint seeking the preventive detention of a Secom coordinator](https://news.google.?oc=5) over reposts of the false story about the patron saint. The judge who received the filing left the request to the pre-trial judge, and Secom says the allegations [are unfounded](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/poder/2026/09/flavio-pede-prisao-de-funcionario-do-planalto-por-repostagens-sobre-nossa-senhora.shtml).

On betting sites, the Finance Ministry [estimates bettors' balances at R$ 1.7 billion](https://www.poder360.com.br/poder-economia/fazenda-estima-em-r-17-bi-saldo-de-apostadores-em-sites-de-apostas/), which can be withdrawn until October 5. Lula [called the ban a "very drastic step"](https://news.google.?oc=5), and Flávio Bolsonaro [again called him "father of Tigrinho"](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiyAFBVV95cUxPWFhrOXN4RjI0OHpiT2RyRGlVX3J5bWFHS1Y5UmI1Qkg4bEprVFJYR3BPQjFpblk2cTBhQXI4VTdrbkNCTWllc0NEcUstQlRmaUUtRHppV3hiRGVycEhpVWtBXzRSSWNoVnYzQjlCelhKNWVwdktlNURUV3IwM3A2QldsUFFjZ3lxNFVuVDFVejFIR3FscU1sV3E0WmFPZWExZHBBZTdWRmdkNnNqTWczVzBPVTlUSHdMdzJqbGEtdVZuTTAzaFlxdQ?oc=5).

The last debate before the first round, on TV Globo on October 1, has four invitees: Lula, Flávio Bolsonaro, Augusto Cury and Ronaldo Caiado. Renan Santos was left out under the legal criterion, of a party with at least five members of Congress elected in 2022, and his campaign [is preparing a protest in front of the broadcaster](https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/colunas/painel/2026/09/renan-santos-prepara-protesto-na-globo-se-ficar-fora-do-debate.shtml). Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro [have not confirmed attendance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQU1RTZjBmbV9vekVCUnJackdlbjFCLUlzZHVIbTFJMmxubnJocjlQNEJGaDhNUW9ldXdGSm9KN24tRG9iVzlxSVFTdjR1NTNjRm5QeTZwR29kQlU2bnNGeTRIellJeE1NdTF1Y3h3VUpFNzZwWThmZ3NhV0N3Qkg3a2JuaHRCMkowb0IwWW1uUlMwazRQQkE?oc=5).

## 4. Divergences of the day

> **Market x poll, third place:** the book switches its leader to Augusto Cury with no new national poll. In the six national polls of September 24, Cury is numerically ahead of Renan Santos in four, tied in one and behind in one.

> **Market x poll, winner:** the gap widens to 14.75pp in favour of Flávio Bolsonaro. In the same six national polls, Lula is ahead in the first round in four, tied in one and behind in one, and Flávio Bolsonaro is ahead in the second round in four.

> **Opinion x contract:** Datafolha measures the worst rating of the Supreme Court since 2019, and the contract on a justice's removal by impeachment before 2027 falls 0.35pp, to 3.00%. Rating the court poorly is not predicting the removal of a justice.

## In summary

**The move of the day was in the third place book, and there the normalized figure confirms the raw one.** In the winner contract, more than half of Flávio Bolsonaro's rise comes from the pair sum.

**With no new national poll since September 24, the calendar concentrates 17 through October 2.** Seven are scheduled for September 29.

**Two judicial acts on campaign advertising arose from requests by Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign, with opposite results.** Lula's jingle is suspended by an injunction of September 22, and the order to delete posts about the patron saint fell at the Supreme Court on September 27.
